_readme: THE ONE PLACE for prices, passes, trial, language access and à-la-carte unlocks. The app (src/config/plans.ts) and the payment server (razorpay-create-order / razorpay-verify) both read this file, so the price shown is always the price charged. Amounts are whole rupees (INR); the server converts to paise. After editing: rebuild the app and redeploy the two razorpay functions.
_popular_note: design label only — never a count or a claim

unlocks._note: an unlocked item = every language version of that video/PDF, forever, for that account

_grace_note: paid passes only (not the trial): full access of that tier for N hours, chosen by the LOCAL hour the pass expired
_postPasses_note: Time-limited Knowledge post access for Free, Pro and Gold (Platinum already has every post). A pass opens the chosen posts in every language (videos + PDFs). View/stream only — downloads stay Platinum-only. Website only; hidden in the Android app.
